reveal.summary: Jon Stewart. Craig Kilborn — Old School's smug boyfriend — was the original Daily Show host, and Stewart took over his desk in January 1999. But Stewart's television story starts earlier, on MTV, home of the network's first talk show: The Jon Stewart Show. The same year he inherited The Daily Show, he played Sonny's roommate in Big Daddy. Trevor Noah later inherited the same desk; Stephen Colbert rose from Stewart's correspondent bench; and every episode ended the same way — with your Moment of Zen.

clueExplanations.explanation: Craig Kilborn led to OLD SCHOOL — a deliberate misdirection. The film was never the point. Kilborn matters because of the desk he left behind.
Jenny McCarthy led to MTV — not about her at all. MTV is where Jon Stewart's talk-show career began in the early 90s.
Trevor Noah led to THE DAILY SHOW — naming the institution that connects Kilborn, Stewart and Noah as successive hosts.
The Late Late Show led to 1999 — the handover year. Kilborn moved to CBS, and Stewart took The Daily Show chair that January.
Big Daddy led to SONNY'S ROOMMATE — Jon Stewart played Kevin Gerrity, Sonny's roommate, in the same year as the handover.
Stephen Colbert led to the sign-off quote — Colbert came up from Stewart's correspondent desk, and 'your Moment of Zen' closed every Stewart episode.

reveal.evidenceToAnswer: The evidence triangulates one figure at the center of a television succession: a predecessor (Kilborn, via Old School), a network origin (MTV), an institution (The Daily Show), a handover year (1999), a film role that rewards looking past the star (Sonny's roommate), and a signature sign-off (your Moment of Zen). Only Jon Stewart sits at the intersection of all six.
majorConnections: Craig Kilborn → original Daily Show host → succeeded by Jon Stewart (January 1999)
MTV → The Jon Stewart Show (1993), the network's first talk show
Big Daddy (1999) → Jon Stewart as Sonny's roommate, the same year as the handover
Stephen Colbert → Daily Show correspondent under Stewart → The Colbert Report
Trevor Noah → inherited the same desk in 2015

reveal.ohMoment: Craig Kilborn wasn't the answer — he was the arrow. The moment you remember who took his desk in 1999, every other piece snaps into place.

entryPoints.description: Old School and Big Daddy give film-comedy fans two doorways; neither requires knowing late-night history to solve.
Singled Out is broadly remembered 90s pop culture; the MTV evidence rewards anyone who knows Stewart's origins there.
Younger players can enter through Trevor Noah and Stephen Colbert without knowing Kilborn at all.
